title: BEYOND Light Show & Meditation
includes: Free Access to the Arcade, Media Room, and Lounge!

blurb:
Ranked the #1 "Thing to Do" in Denver on both TripAdvisor and Yelp, the world-famous BEYOND Laser Light Experience is a mind-expanding, audio-visual immersive light and sound show featured in hundreds of global newspapers, magazines, and television shows.

In addition to BEYOND, your day pass grants you unlimited access to the Church's retro arcade lounge, art gallery, movie theater, and Gandhi Garden, with dozens of Instagram worthy picture spots throughout the Church. 

Our Retro Arcade Lounge includes:
Arcade Emulators with over 10,000+ Games on Free Play
Galaga Arcade (Vintage)
Centipede Arcade (Vintage)
Super Off Road Arcade (Vintage)
Mario Kart on a 26 foot movie theater screen (Epic!)
Skee Ball on free play 
Incredible photo opps
Golden Tee (Vintage)
Art from world famous artists 
Every board game imaginable from your childhood
Shawn White’s couch set (no, seriously…it's here)
Ping-Pong
Art Garden 
Insanely Unique Gift Shop and Lounge with items you won't find anywhere else!
